task.title: Fix round 1: flow record and guide (F-009, F-010, guide alignment with the fixes)
task.description:
Two things, both in files of the documentation lane. The task is done when both finish lines hold, `bun run docs:check` passes from the repository root, and nothing outside the owned files changed.

1. The guide after the fixes of review round 1. Tasks T17 and T18 changed what a user sees (their result files say exactly what; the strings are in the TSX at head): the Relationships fact of the details panel also shows the second-step count when there are second-step relationships (`2 incoming · 2 outgoing · 1 second-step`); a relationship from a node to itself is neither listed nor counted; the Filters popover opens above its button when there is no room below it, closes when you leave the Metaproject view, and stays open across Graph, Wiki and OpenSpec; on return to Metaproject from another view everything is as you left it and the catalog is re-read quietly, so the freshness banner is current; Back to an earlier OpenSpec document returns to the place you were reading. Finish line: every sentence of docs/docs/guides/desktop-metaproject.md that describes one of these parts of the screen matches the screen, and a reader is told what they need to use it; the guide stays a task-oriented guide, not a list of changes, so a detail no reader acts on is left out. The constraints of the earlier guide tasks stay: do not touch the paragraph that starts 'Desktop sends read requests', the section 'Inspect the module from the CLI', or the table under 'Recover from common problems'; keep the image paths, the stated limits, the guide's voice and second person. AC21 keeps holding.

2. Finding F-010. The dispatch files of T9 and T15 name `resolved/T<n>.implement.json` as existing and require `results/T<n>.result.json`; neither file was ever written, so both guide tasks ran without a resolved-context file and were accepted on the orchestrator's own checks. The orchestrator has now written the two resolved-context files, on the current head. Finish line: `results/T9.result.json` and `results/T15.result.json` exist and each passes `keryx skills contracts validate <result> --schema task-implementer-output --resolved <its resolved file>`. Each says what that task changed in the guide (commit 5955bf547 is T9, commit be1e15e8d is T15: read them with `git show`), cites every must_read entry of its resolved file in `project_context_applied` as read now, and says in `notes` that the result was written during T21, after the task had been accepted, because review round 1 found the file missing. Where a must_read rule asks for something the guide at head does not meet, fix it in the guide under point 1 and say so; where a rule does not apply to a documentation file, say why in its citation.

Scope freeze: fix the findings named here and nothing else. Anything else you notice goes into `noticed_not_touched`; a choice the plan's state x event matrix does not decide goes into `behavior_changes` with `needs_operator: true` and its alternatives. A reviewer's `suggested_fix` is a hypothesis: reproduce the finding first, check the suggestion against the matrix, and say in `notes` where your fix diverged from it or where a finding did not reproduce. Existing tests are not weakened or deleted to make room for a fix.
